Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the Planner incorrectly compared the birth years of the two directors, concluding that Boaz Yakin (born in 1965) was born earlier than Pupi Avati (born in 1938). While accurate data was retrieved regarding both directors' birth years, the Planner misinterpreted the chronological comparison, incorrectly reversing the logical conclusion. This mirrors a logical comparison error seen in other cases where numerical or chronological data are mishandled. The Planner failed to properly synthesize the gathered information and prematurely declared the task complete without reviewing the consistency of its conclusion with the numerical facts.
